# Nested combinations

1. **Ordered** paragraph with *emphasis*, [link](https://example.invalid), `code` and $x^2$.

   > Quote inside a loose item.
   >
   > - [x] Task inside the quote
   > - Plain bullet

   ```rust
   let nested = "中文";
   ```

2. Paragraph before an image.

   ![Nested image](tiles.png "List caption")

   Paragraph after the image.

> | **Header** | *Math* |
> | :--- | ---: |
> | [`linked code`](https://example.invalid) | $\frac{a}{b}$ |
> | 中文~~删除~~ | <sup>2</sup> |

Text after a list and table quote.
